name: Uchiyama Kazumi
source:
Atsushi's mother.

She is a single mother and works at a hospital as a pharmacist. She is a slightly overweight, gentle woman with a calm atmosphere.

She has a strong bond with her only son through sex.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mamatuma.htmll]official site[/url].
